changelog.what: First version, written from the published rows with nothing in the way.

question: Do you want your agent to edit documents other people are working on?
worry: Asked to improve a shared document, it rewrites the section a colleague is still writing, or reorganises a folder other people rely on.
you_get: Your changes to shared work are suggestions until you say otherwise.
line: Do not edit, rename or move shared documents; suggest changes in a comment or a copy unless I ask you to edit that document.
paragraph: Documents and folders other people use are not only mine. Put suggested changes in a comment, a suggestion or a copy. Edit, rename or move a shared document or folder only when I ask for that one, and say what you changed.
